reviewer: root primary successor and effective-design review after bounded independent audits
reason: The shared M006 destination does not by itself identify one produced result. Recipient/input identity and resulting-state identity are different claims; no changed-action pair or separately observed result response is nominated. Independent outputs need not yield visibly different destination behavior.

design.contrast: one shared result/state versus two independent results coincidentally written at one destination
design.countermodel: The same destination may be a repeated notation or editor-compressed location with no shared semantic result.
design.falsifier: Independent destination/state coding shows the two incoming actions require distinct results, or a matched fan-out has no shared downstream state constraint.
design.prediction: A held fan-out should preserve one destination state and constrain both incoming actions to the same result class; an independent-output model predicts separable destination behavior when one incoming action changes.
design.principal_risk: Current destination/result labels are working readings and no separately named final result is admitted.
design.related: Near GDT697/GDT701/GDT702, but targets the semantic consequence of fan-out topology rather than merely composing or counting relation edges.

source_evidence.quote:
The atlas now gives one exact home to every current edge.  Seven components
contain one edge, M006 is a two-action fan-out to one written destination, and
M007 is the sole serial chain with a written intermediate product.  The last
action in every component still lacks an admitted, separately named final
result.

design.unit: two admitted action edges converging on one exact written destination node

blockers.detail: The shared M006 destination does not by itself identify one produced result. Recipient/input identity and resulting-state identity are different claims; no changed-action pair or separately observed result response is nominated. Independent outputs need not yield visibly different destination behavior.

all_of.detail: Choose recipient or result semantics, nominate a specific action contrast and observable response, and restrict the rival to a different predicted response. Identify additional eligible fan-outs and held cases for that fixed rule. A structural endpoint does not require confirmed English/German meanings; semantic identity must be independently justified for its own claim.

not_sufficient: Replaying graph-node incidence or connectedness as its own independent endpoint.
Reusing inherited working glosses as independent state observations.
More pages or another adjacent word without the fixed endpoint/model contrast.

relations.detail: Primary source observation for this unreviewed proposal; not a semantic identity or a successful test.

claim_ceiling: No new test selected. Existing topology and historical candidate meanings remain preserved; earlier source-only quote repair is retained exactly.
